caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jar set against a plain, beige background. The jar is rounded with a narrow neck and a slightly flared rim. Its surface is predominantly a light brown or tan color, with subtle hints of reddish and yellowish areas that suggest glazes or shading. There are two notable blue designs on the upper portion of the jar: one is a circular or looped shape, and the other is a stylized bird facing to the right, shown in profile. These designs are simply executed and are the only decorations on the otherwise smooth surface of the jar. The artist's name, "GEO. LOUGHRIDGE," is written in small letters in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
